subject: Go/No-Go Prep — MAP close runway, signature timing & onboarding start
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@stellarsuite.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Andrew Kim <andrew.kim@corpserve.io>
Date: 2027-09-12T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft + proposed sign window (need confirmation)

Marcus — thanks for the walkthrough today. Attached is our consolidated MAP (MAP_v3.pdf) with the dates we discussed. Two quick asks so we can lock: 

1) Final approval window for signatures — our legal needs a 72-hour window with at least two business-day overlap for countersignature. Can Redwood commit to a signer-week of Sep 27–29?
2) Onboarding start — we want production data piped in by Oct 4 (week of Oct 4). That means a hard go/no-go by Oct 1 EOD PT.

I’m copying Andrew from procurement to confirm the DocuSign flow and SOW items. If you can confirm the signature runway and the Oct 4 target by EOD Monday (9/13), we’ll schedule the final exec review on our side.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Platform Integrations
StellarSuite

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf (20 pages), SOW_STELLAR_v2.docx (redlines included)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@stellarsuite.com>, Andrew Kim <andrew.kim@corpserve.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + proposed sign window (need confirmation)

Elena / Andrew — appreciate the clear timeline. Quick answers and open items below: 

- Signature runway: we can support signer availability Sep 27–29. I’ve blocked a 2-hour window on Sep 28 (internal legal + sales ops) to be on standby for any DocuSign issues.
- Go/no-go threshold: recommend we require three approvals to flip to green: Sales (me), Customer Success (Laura) for onboarding resources, and Revenue Ops for billing cadence. If any one of the three raises a blocker, we treat as amber and pause.
- Onboarding start: Oct 4 is feasible if the signed SOW is in our system by Oct 1 23:59 PT and we have confirmed the onboarding kick team (Laura to confirm headcount).

Next steps: Laura — can you confirm the onboarding roster and whether we need any extra prework (sample data access, test keys) before Oct 1? I’ll also circulate the DocuSign link as soon as legal confirms the final SOW version.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: signature-window.ics (proposed signer availability slot)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena@stellarsuite.com>
Cc: Andrew Kim <andrew.kim@corpserve.io>
Date: 2027-09-14T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + proposed sign window (need confirmation)

Looping in confirmation from onboarding: we can staff two engineers (one infra, one integration lead) and one CS manager for the Oct 4 start. Prework checklist I need completed by Sep 29: 
- Test dataset export (S3 link or secure FTP) + sample size (<= 5k rows)
- VPN/IP allowlist details for our dedicated staging (we’ll send IP ranges)
- Finalized SOW with environment details so infra can size GPU pools and reserve capacity.

If any of those items slip past Sep 29, the realistic earliest start is Oct 11 because of resource scheduling. Marcus — I’ll plan for Sep 30 as a dry-run of the onboarding playbook with Stella’s integration lead (30–45 minutes).

Cheers,
Laura
Head of Customer Onboarding, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena@stellarsuite.com>
Cc: Andrew Kim <andrew.kim@corpserve.io>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Go/No-Go decision & execution notes (DEAL-4921)

Team — after reviewing the MAP, SOW redlines, and legal signoff queue, I’m confirming the green light contingent on two things being completed by 2027-09-29 EOD PT: 

1) SOW finalization: Marcus to confirm DocuSign is ready and that the SOW in DocuSign matches the SOW_STELLAR_v2.docx redlines.
2) Preflight access: Elena to provide the test dataset link and IP allowlist so infra can pre-stage.

If both are done by 9/29 EOD PT, Redwood will: 
- Reserve dedicated capacity for the Oct 4 onboarding kickoff.
- Route the signed documents to RevOps for billing onboarding the next business day.
- Add a canary traffic ramp: 10% production traffic first week, full cutover no earlier than week 3 post-kickoff.

If either item is delayed past 9/29 EOD PT, this becomes an amber decision and the earliest start shifts to Oct 11. Elena — please confirm the dataset link and legal receipt of DocuSign by reply. Marcus — once you post the DocuSign link, I’ll stamp the approval in the deal record.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
